thread:
emily_sales: Hey team — Orion Health is asking for SOC 2 / ISO artifacts for a POC. They specifically want: a pen-test attestation letter, control mappings, and confirmation we can run an air-gapped on-prem POC (temporary VPC peering). Also asking for pricing delta Dedicated vs Private for a 2-week POC and whether we can shorten billing lag for trial credits. They need evidence within 5 business days. Who can own?

rowan_solutions: I can run point on the artifacts. We can share SOC2 summary + control mapping spreadsheet. ISO certs are only public copies, can share link. For the pen-test attestation we have a template but security needs the PoC scope before signing. Timeline ~3–4 business days after scope is approved. Air-gapped on-prem is supported but infra kickoff needed.

matt_security: Quick checklist from security: we need PoC scope (IP ranges, duration, test types), statement whether they require a red-team engagement, and the minimal data retention rules for the environment. If they want an immediate procurement letter we can provide a "pending attestation" template with expected sign date. We cannot include raw vuln reports in the letter.

olivia_gts: On pricing — high level: Dedicated POC estimate ~ $450/day for reserved nodes, Private on-prem has a $3k mobilization fee + ~$700/day for infra ops for a short POC. I can put exact calc in a sheet and DM procurement. We can offer a one-time trial credit (up to 30%) if they commit to a paid contract within 30d.

emily_sales: @olivia_gts please drop the numbers here and in a PDF for procurement. Also they asked for staging creds to test networking — can we provide ephemeral keys?

infra-oncall: We can provision VPC peering / private connector in ~72h once we have CIDR + contact + ticket. We'll need their NOC email and allowed CIDR blocks. Example CLI we use for staging peering:
```
redwood p2p create --cidr 10.20.0.0/16 --env staging --owner emily_sales@redwood
```
We also need to schedule a short networking call.

deploy-bot: Ephemeral keys created for thread owner: id=ephemeral-abc123, expires_in=48h (staging). Test creds posted to secure vault.

matt_security: Also note: if they want HSM/KMS integration details for legal, share key rotation policy and we can redact customer-specific ARN. We need an NDA signed before we share any sensitive infra diagrams.

rowan_solutions: I'll attach SOC2 mapping and the pen-test attestation template to the customer email. Will ask security for the provisional/pending letter if they need something for procurement.

emily_sales: Thanks all. I'll push back the customer timeline to 10 business days for infra + pen-test sign-off and confirm whether they actually need an air-gapped environment or just private VPC peering. Sending follow-up to Orion now. :thumbsup:
